title: FRONT KNUCKLE
interpretation_notes: Reconstructed from official SolidWorks drawing: FRONT KNUCKLE (AL 7075 T6, stock 105x130x80 mm).
Overall height 129.66 mm exactly matches printed dimension from bottom lug to top lug.
Central bearing hub contains printed Ø25.00 mm through bore along the wheel axis.
Left side carries two disc brake caliper mounting ears with printed Ø8.00 mm holes.
Right side carries the steering arm with double-shear clevis fork and Ø8.00 mm through holes.
C-shaped upright spine connects upper and lower A-arm wishbone ball-joint lugs (Ø8.00 mm vertical holes).
All dimensions fit cleanly within the 105 x 130 x 80 mm raw material billet.
